name: AI Usage
description: At-a-glance usage monitor for Claude (Claude Code & Cowork), ChatGPT/Codex, and GitHub Copilot. Reads local Claude/Codex session logs and the GitHub billing API.

options.label: GitHub username
options.help: Your GitHub login — enables the Copilot panel. Leave blank to hide it.

options.label: GitHub token
options.help: A fine-grained personal access token with 'Plan' (read-only) permission on your account. Used only server-side to read your Copilot premium-request usage; never sent to the page. Create one at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens.

options.label: Copilot monthly quota
options.help: Included premium requests per month for your Copilot plan — sets the gauge denominator.

options.label: Show Claude 5-hour & weekly limits
options.help: Reads your live Claude usage via your local Claude sign-in (~/.claude/.credentials.json, backed up before any token refresh) and polls api.anthropic.com at most every 5 min. Account-wide — matches on every machine. Turn off to show only local token stats.

options.label: Claude data folder
options.help: Advanced — override the Claude Code data dir. Blank = ~/.claude.

options.label: Show ChatGPT 5-hour & weekly limits (live)
options.help: Reads your live ChatGPT/Codex usage via your local Codex sign-in (~/.codex/auth.json, read-only) from chatgpt.com every 2 min. Account-wide — matches on every machine. Turn off to use only the last local log snapshot.

options.label: Codex data folder
options.help: Advanced — override the Codex CLI data dir. Blank = ~/.codex.

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the panels re-scan the logs and re-poll GitHub.
